title: Master's Thesis: Dynamic Attention Steering & Memory Management in Agents
description: Designing dynamic attention-steering mechanisms and structured memory architectures to mitigate behavioral drift and maintain long-horizon stability in interactive multi-agent simulations. Investigating how selective memory retrieval and internal representation control support continual adaptation.

title: Experience Replay Benchmark in Reinforcement Learning
description: Implemented and benchmarked experience replay sampling strategies (endpoint_replay_benchmark.py) in Python to evaluate sample efficiency, memory retention, and learning stability near trajectory endpoints in reinforcement learning environments.

title: Statistical Estimation & Optimization Foundations in Code
description: Developed an open-source collection of modular Python implementations covering Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), Maximum A Posteriori (MAP), regularization strategies, and gradient-based numerical optimization algorithms from scratch.

title: Quantifying Gender Bias in Word Embeddings (GloVe)
description: Conducted a rigorous statistical and geometric subspace analysis of pre-trained GloVe word embeddings across 380+ occupational titles, measuring representational biases against empirical U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics workforce data.

title: Multi-Label Emotion & Personality Classification (B.Sc. Thesis)
description: Developed a deep learning NLP pipeline on the GoEmotions dataset using Word2Vec, GloVe, and Transformer embeddings across LSTM, GRU, BiLSTM, and BiGRU architectures, achieving a micro-average F1 score of 48.9% and validation AUC of 0.6009.
